title: Golden Rings in Black Ash
description: A dark, textured mound resembling a human head and shoulders sits centered on a bed of black granular material. The form is embedded with numerous golden rings of various sizes and designs that catch the light, while the background consists of a dark bokeh field with blurred purple, pink, and yellow lights.
prompt: A mysterious dark textured mound shaped like a human head and shoulders emerges from a bed of fine black ash and sand. The entire form is covered with dozens of scattered golden rings of different sizes and ornate designs. The figure is positioned centrally against a dark background filled with beautiful out-of-focus bokeh lights in purple, pink, and yellow. Dramatic lighting, highly detailed textures, surreal and melancholic atmosphere.
